title: AI Representations of Mental Health Stigma: Quantifying the Gap Between AI Estimations and Human Perceptions Across Gender Groups Using GPT-Based LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Role-based prompting of LLMs to simulate survey responses regarding mental health stigma and help-seeking attitudes from the perspective of male, female, and nonbinary individuals, followed by a quantitative comparison of the generated scores across gender groups and against a baseline of real-world human survey data (the Healthy Minds Study).
